To evaluate the credit rating of the issuer for FY2025 Q4, we analyze its financial position:
The issuer shows a strong capital structure with total assets of $58,167 million against total liabilities of $27,401 million (equity of $18,899 million, representing a solid equity-to-assets ratio of 32.5%), alongside an excellent liquidity profile with a current ratio of 2.29. Additionally, profitability is robust with an operating margin of 14.4% ($811 million in operating income on $5,633 million in revenue) and positive net income of $406 million. These solid balance sheet metrics, high liquidity, and consistent profitability support a strong investment-grade profile.

DECISION: A-
